$comment: Registry of every version number the published docs state about an
OpenAdapt component, and what kind of claim each one is.
Enforced by scripts/check_published_version_claims.py.
Why this exists: on 2026-07-27 openadapt-flow 1.24.0 published and four
sentences on docs.openadapt.ai -- including one on the security-review
page -- kept asserting that the live runner reported 'the published Flow
1.23.0 identity'. The NUMBER was right at that time because the managed
runtime pinned 1.23.0; the word 'published' was what became false. Nothing
detect that, because no machine-readable record said which numbers are
supposed to track the current release and which are deliberately frozen.
kind:
pypi-latest        This text asserts the CURRENT PUBLISHED release of
`package`. Checked against PyPI daily; a mismatch
fails.
pinned-deployment  A version something is deliberately pinned to. It is
NOT a claim about the newest release and must never
be reworded into one. Bump it only with evidence.
historical         A version some retained measurement was taken on.
Frozen forever; bumping it would falsify the record.
Adding a 'published X.Y.Z' style sentence to docs/ without a matching
pypi-latest entry here fails the check.

claims.evidence: openadapt-cloud origin/main 4d653f37812fe568e15750d6f55bfa952e0641e9 runner/runtime-version.json pins openadapt_flow 1.34.0 at release commit 30fc60e55778a0e0f92b9776117cafcfe2512249 (wheel sha256 56d32818989cb3a92830080ead39e10b08718c55e00988117f22cbfeaac98854; sdist sha256 a941a70015fe91897e655bfc9bf83e6cf8fbcf8bd4e4c7206ffb133c505203f8). Cloud has pinned 1.34.0 since c6c705d457d09f4628dd23a6fa26fbbdd87f87ff (2026-08-28). This records the configured artifact pin, not live deployment or hosted acceptance. The docs state it as of verified_on.
